ENGLISH:
Egypt is a nation in the process of modernization. However, the central authority in the country is weak and we have three powerful factions in the country that will react to our actions.
 The §BNubala§! that represent the military and nobility.
 The §BBurjwaziyyin§! that represent the middle class and non aristocratic upper class.
 The §BUlama§! that represent the scholars and religious establishment.
 §RShould any of these factions become dissatisfied with our actions and turn disloyal, they might coup us to ensure that their vision of the future is the one we adhere to.§!

A §Gloyal§! faction supports the government. A §Wneutral§! faction is somewhere in the middle, they might be close to becoming disloyal. A §Rdisloyal§! faction dislikes our recent actions, and unless we do something to appease them they might coup us.

The factions and what actions they support are: 

 The §BNubala§!, they represent the military and nobility. They value military strength, expanding the nation via conquest and only support some minor reforms. 
 The §BBurjwaziyyin§!, they represent the middle class and the non aristocratic upper class. They value modernization, peace and major reforms to the political and administrative system. 
 The §BUlama§!, who represent the scholars and the religious establishment. They value adherence to religious laws, supporting the Caliph of Mecca, and distrust any form of change.

The Nubala have seen our recent actions as a threat to Egypt and their power. They have recruited several high ranking generals in the military and yesterday they couped the government. We are now ruled by council of nobles, and the monarch has been put under house arrest and is only being kept around as a symbol of legitimacy. §RThe Nubala faction became disloyal and couped you. This removes access to all the other faction decisions, and stops you from further cores in Africa.§!

The Burjwaziyyin have seen our recent actions as a threat to Egypt and their power. They bribed several high ranking officers in the royal guard and yesterday they couped the government. We are now ruled by a meritocratic council of influential merchants, philosophers and politicians. The monarch has been deposed and a republic has been declared. §RThe Burjwaziyyin faction became disloyal and couped you. This removes access to all the other faction decisions, and stops you from gaining cores in both Africa and the Middle East.§!

The Ulama have seen our recent actions as a threat to Egypt and the Islamic religion. They requested aid from the Rashidun, and yesterday an arabic army marched in to Cairo and couped the government. We are now ruled by religious fanatics, and the Sultan has been executed for his betrayal of the faith. §RThe Ulama faction became disloyal and couped you. This removes access to all the other faction decisions and while you can still expand in Africa, expansion in the Middle East now has harder requiremens.§!

Since the Rashidun failed to crush the Uprising of 1811 Egypt has controlled Jerusalem and kept the region stable. However, the city is the third holiest in all of Islam, and de jure belongs to the Caliphate. They have now sent yet another demand for us to relinquish the city and that our armies must leave the entire region. Unlike their previous demands this one has gone so far as to call us kafirs, and that if we do not end our occupation we will be declared apostates and that our next meeting will be upon the battlefield.

The creation of the University of Cairo is finally finished! The building has become one of the marvels of Cairo, drawing international praise and jealousy. A slight problem has appeared however. Despite the University being requested by the Burjwaziyyin and funded in large parts by them, it seems the other factions believe they get to have a say in the curriculum at the University. The Nubala have demanded that the University should be focused on a martial education, teaching young men how to serve as competent officers in the army. The Ulama have demanded that the University should instead have a religious doctrine, teaching students about Islam and how to live a pious life. The Burjwaziyyin are of course not interested in either of these alternatives, instead wanting the University to be a modern one, with a focus on history, economy, and the arts. The situation is in a deadlock, and thus we have now received individual requests from all three groups asking us to take their side in the debate. So what will the University teach?

Through clever politicking and outmaneuvering our enemies, we have succesfully established the King as the source of power in Egypt. The Nubala, Burjwaziyyin, and Ulama have all been defeated and learnt their place. Our dynasty shall live forevermore!
Show Faction Status
This decision will trigger an event that shows the current loyalties of the different factions in the country.
Proclaim the Kingdom of Egypt

With our recent strides in modernization we have started to have an increased dialogue with European powers. In these meetings they treat us as beneath them, as a mere sultan while they are kings and emperors. This insult to the Sultan cannot go unanswered, and we will thus proclaim Egypt a kingdom to strengthen our international prestige. §GThis decision unlocks the purging mechanic.§!
Lay claim to Syria

The Sultan of Rum was given the lands of Syria to administer in the name of the Persian Emperor. He has mismanaged this land and simply used it in his personal jihad against Cappadocia, ignoring the people of Syria. The people of the levant are in part descendants of the Egyptian people, and we have a moral obligation to ensure their wellbeing.
Establish a spearhead in Anatolia
The Sultanate of Rum has failed the people of Anatolia and the Islamic world. We must take their land and use it to do what they could not do: crush the enemies of Islam.
Invade Anatolia
The time has come to push even further and lay claim to southern Anatolia. We will prove that we are the true heirs to Saladin.
Offer Rum our Protection

With the weakened state of Rum we could perhaps use this to our opportunity. We shall send them an offer of vassalization in exchange for our protection and assistance in future wars against the Christians. §GShould they accept this deal you will unlock the overlord path, letting you vassalize large parts of the middle east. It does however also block you from conquering much of that land for yourself.§!
The Bey of Anatolia
With our conquests in Anatolia we can now gain the region of Diyarbakir from our loyal Bey in exchange for helping them expand even further in Anatolia.
The Bey of Trebizond
With our latest conquests we can establish a Beylik in the historical lands of Trebizond. It will be useful in any potential wars against the Armenian Kingdom.
The Bey of Dulkadir
After our negotiation with the Bey of Anatolia we now control large parts of the former Beylik of Dulkadir. We can reestablish the Beylik, giving us a loyal governor of a historically unruly region.
The Bey of Mesopotamia
Now that Iraq is firmly under our control we can turn it into a loyal Beylik, serving as a shield between us and the Persians.
The Grand Dockyard Project

With our position as the dominant power in the Middle East secured we can now make some territorial adjustments. We will take over the administration of several key ports along the Anatolian coast, further increasing our potential as a naval hegemon.
Embrace Africa

§GThis decision unlocks decisions to gain cores in Africa.§! The Ulama have long wished for us to pursue a foreign policy centered around converting the peoples of Africa to the one true faith. They have also wished for us to take a more active stance against the Umayyad Caliphate, since their existence is an insult to the legitimate Caliph of Mecca.
The Annexation of Tripoli

Tripoli has served as our border with the Umayyads for awhile, yet there has always been a concern that if we were to end up at war with them they would have easy access to our capital. By annexing Tripoli we can push this border further West, and further away from the Egyptian heartland.
The Algerian Administration
Algeria serves as a usefull trading hub between Africa and Italy. Taking it for ourselves will give us access to these riches, and deprive the Iberians of them.
The Rise of the Maghrebi
Now that Morocco is part of our country we can begin the process of integrating the Maghrebi people into our administration.
The King of Ethiopia

Ethiopia has always been a thorn in our side. By annexing them we could finally secure the southern flank of the nation and would grant our mighty monarch an additional title, increasing our international prestige.
The Ways of the Desert

The recent conquests in Africa have given us many new subjects. Some of these subjects are well versed in how to traverse the harsh climates of the southern regions. If we were to give them the proper funding, they believe that they could establish settlements and turn the inhospitable terrain to our advantage.
Further Settlements in Africa
The previous project was a great success! The obvious move now is to repeat the project for a new area.
